surfaces.description: @human items refuse by:agent; no scratch line is written

surfaces.notes: AC-ENFORCE: write_attestation dies before scratch write when item.human and by==agent.

surfaces.notes: AC-EMPTY fail-closed: qc_run_cmd sets run_rc=127 and an install hint; print_eval does not skip.
